content:
li: Heads-up — I'm seeing per-token latency spikes on a handful of Dedicated pools after the kernel-select experiment. Can we correlate with route-level KPIs and KV-cache churn?
chris: I pushed the kernel selector tweak yesterday afternoon (canary). Any specific pool IDs?
li: pool-eu-14 and pool-us-07. Sampled traces show jumps at token ~12-16 where batching heuristics seem to change.
mira: saw this in profiling too. The runtime switched to the 'wide-attn' kernel for short sequences; that increases mem copies for some batches.
li: hmm. do we have metric panels that break token latency into 'compute', 'kv-lookup', 'enqueue' and 'wait-for-batch'?
nora: Not yet as a single per-route panel. I can add a stacked breakdown, but need PromQL for the new counters.
chris: we emit counters: token_latency_total_ms, token_latency_kv_ms, token_latency_kernel_ms, token_latency_queue_ms with labels {route, pool, kernel}.
sam: suggest a query for per-route 95th token compute time:
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, sum by (route) (increase(token_latency_kernel_ms[5m])) / sum by (route) (increase(token_latency_total_ms_count[5m])))
```
li: that looks useful. Can we also surface KV cache hit/miss ratio per pool and correlate with spill events?
mira: KV exposes `kv_hits_total` and `kv_misses_total` labels per pool+route. I'll add a heatmap and an alert when miss_ratio > 0.18 for 10m.
chris: FYI noisiness here looks like noisy-neighbor: pool-us-07 had a sudden drop in headroom (alloc vs commit) and concurrent spikes from a single route (r:chatbot-beta).
ora: I'll build a composite dashboard tile: left column per-pool headroom (gpu_mem_free/gpu_mem_total), middle token-latency breakdown, right KV hit ratio + recent evictions.
devops-bot: deploy:dashboard/eng-platform/token-latency-breakdown v1 -> prod at 2026-02-17T18:02:10Z :rocket:
li: thanks. After deploy, can we run a short load test that reproduces the pattern and capture CPU/GPU profiler (nvprof) traces? Need the kernel boundary times.
mira: yes — I'll coordinate a 2-min ramp on r:chatbot-beta at 90qps and attach profiler.
sam: small note — the batching heuristic has a micro-threshold: if average queuing latency < 12ms we expand batch window; that combined with wide-attn kernel causes more copies. Might be worth trying a narrow-window A/B on pool-us-07.
chris: agree. propose: revert kernel selector on pool-us-07 -> measure 30m; if tail improves by >8% and cost delta < 2%, keep revert; otherwise keep canary and tune batching.
ora: I'll add the rollback-runbook to the dashboard tile (button). Also instrument a per-request tag so we can trace affected requests across rollback.
li: one more ask — add a compact per-route KPI that shows 'tokens/sec per GPU' and 'effective headroom' so sales/CS can see capacity impact clearly.
mira: adding panel and a short note about quantization interaction (some quant profiles increase kernel time unexpectedly).
chris: ack. If the profiler confirms mem-copy hotspots, we should prioritize a focused kernel patch rather than global selector revert.
li: perfect. thanks everyone — next steps: nora to build dashboard tiles (ETA 6h), mira to run profiler + loadtest (ETA 3h), chris to prepare rollback patch + cost check (ETA 4h).
(thumbs-up reactions and a followup thread expected after the profiler run)
